title: Install advances without confirmation when checks pass
need: Check required tools and repair owned shell PATH blocks automatically for login, interactive, non-login and SSH contexts. Plain bash -c inherits PATH from a fresh parent; stripped environments must supply PATH or BASH_ENV. Uninstall removes only marked blocks. On failure, name the cause and offer Retry Install. Keep shell-file changes in Review and the final summary, including changes made before a failed attempt. Show each context’s actual winner and canonical launcher; a successful login cannot hide an interactive conflict. After owned-block repair, name remaining overrides and startup files for manual correction without repeating ineffective repair.
surface: Setup Install recovery and finish summary
review: Source regressions cover per-context actual and canonical paths, clean resolution, late interactive Bash shadowing, truthful manual recovery, owned-block repair and repeat idempotence. A controlled conflict/correction observation remains owed in the shared installer regression.
